_doc: Registered FILE-shaped role digests for cap_check.py (SYSTEM/SCHEMA.md § Role digests). One cap vault-wide; a per-file `cap_words:` frontmatter key overrides. Register a new advisor's current-state.md / generated status file here. Do NOT register whole project notes (a hub digest = the hub's Now & next section). Empty on purpose in the starter — add paths as you create digest files.
_doc_sections: Section caps: each entry caps one `## heading` in every note matching its globs. Orientation surfaces stay short; history moves verbatim to trails/<slug>-trail.md (SYSTEM/SCHEMA.md § Orientation caps + trails). Measured by script, never by model estimate. Over cap is a WARN under plain lint.sh (LINT_STRICT=1 FAILs); a dated `cap_exception:` frontmatter key declares an exception.
